calendars.missing: Omit unavailable calendar. Never synthesize weekdays or relabel observed SPY dates.

examples.emptyBundleResult: prepareSourceInput at an explicit asOf succeeds as an honest empty boundary; unchanged engine reports INCOMPLETE / UNKNOWN_CALENDAR / missing source.
examples.completeSyntheticExample: Executable test 'per-session prospective vintages accumulate a complete R0 window and replay through the snapshot schema' builds a fully artificial explicit exchange schedule, 704 independently captured equity rows, six VIX rows, two CFE monthly rows and one catalog. It obtains COMPLETE/R0 and exact snapshot replay. This proves plumbing, not actual prospective market coverage.
examples.fixtureCaveat: All test raw bytes, timestamps and OFFICIAL-format packets are synthetic. They are not production calendar versions and must not be installed as real exchange data.

operatorWorkflow: Store exact source captures outside the repository using the governed external runtime store. The capture wrapper must use existing provider fetch bytes; do not add a second network call.
Assemble a JSON bundle externally with explicit source kinds, source contracts and capture envelopes. Retain every upstream raw capture for transformed BTC/GLD tables.

Supply separate reviewed versioned calendar packets for equity, VIX, CFE, BTC fund reporting and GLD valuation. Preserve raw schedule capture and normalization hash; coverage must be complete for the declared interval.

For a prospective window, select each observation from its actual contemporaneous capture via observationDates. A newly fetched full history cannot replace original per-session vintages. Mixed R2 parents remain R2 and are ineligible in R0 mode.

Use one explicit contemporaneously known CFE monthly catalog and current near-month histories containing Trade Date,Futures,Settle. Missing nearest identity/settlement remains missing; a later contract is not promoted.
Set V2_SHADOW_INPUT to the external bundle path under the root integration configuration. The integration persists original bundle bytes by hash before normalization. V1 remains public authority.
Inspect snapshot sourceStatus, issues, raw capture references and calendarStatus. A missing reliable calendar is an operational INCOMPLETE result, not permission to relax freshness.
Retain the normalized JSON input and engine/snapshot versions with each snapshot; exact replay uses these bytes rather than current provider values.

provenance.rawBoundary: SHA256 and envelope hashes detect local corruption and retain identity. They do not authenticate provider origin, certify a manual calendar transcription, or independently prove an operator-supplied historical timestamp.
provenance.nativeExtraction: BTC/GLD JSON preserves exact extraction bytes plus upstream raw bytes and an explicit transform version. These are declared transformations for audit; provider HTML/PDF table semantic correctness still requires reviewed extraction.
provenance.normalizedIdentity: JSON representation of bulk normalized source rows and histories is materialized once per vintage, detached and frozen before any evaluation. Each cut creates a fresh asOf-bearing input and JSON-materializes only its newly assembled VX packet. Persisted normalized input replays without representation drift; caller objects remain unchanged.
provenance.providerPublication: sourcePublishedAt remains null. actual capturedAt/availableAt is the conservative availability bound for those exact bytes, never a provider publication claim.
provenance.sourceSubstitution: Endpoint/source identity checks plus frozen normalizers reject FRED VIX substitution, Yahoo close for adjclose, or CFE Close for Settle.
provenance.rawHashes: Native JSON normalized packet vintageHash is explicitly the exact raw byte hash, including original whitespace; sourceCapture and upstreamCapture identities remain in the ledger.

replay.R0Eligibility: PROSPECTIVE origin, reliable OFFICIAL calendar known at capture completion, and observationDate equals that source calendar's latest closed session at capture completion. Row keeps exact capture availability bound.
replay.olderRows: All older rows in the same new payload default to R2. R2_IMPORT is always R2, including when its observation is the current session. R2 upstream native extraction cannot upgrade its derived row.
replay.packetAggregation: Mixed parent classes propagate weakest replay class; distinct incompatible source versions/native units are rejected. No filling, interpolation or state smoothing.
replay.R1: No unproved R1 reconstruction is invented. Mode R1 can conservatively admit proved R0 parents; historical R2 parents remain ineligible. A genuine R1 reconstruction would require separately governed vintage-integrity proof not supplied by this work.
replay.historical: Existing 1930 historical dates remain R2; no archive file is relabeled or rewritten.
replay.qualification: Synthetic R0 schema tests are not PIT OOS evidence; live event counts are not automatically increased by fixtures.

freshness.expectedSession: Resolved separately from each calendar and caller asOf.
freshness.observedSession: Original economic observationDate, retained per normalized row.
freshness.status: Engine sourceStatus reports AVAILABLE, STALE_OR_WRONG_SESSION, UNKNOWN_CALENDAR, TEMPORALLY_INELIGIBLE, missing or normalizer-specific failure; no V1 availability exception.
freshness.vxObservationEnd: Loader propagates latest evidenced observationEndAt of the two near-contract parents after frozen assembly. Unknown parent ends retain conservative day-end; equity close is never used as CFE settlement clock.

boundedCost.algorithm: Cold vintage: validate hashes/provenance and parse raw sources once; source-family capture-time calendar resolutions use a bounded local memo, session-close lookup uses Maps, row selection uses Sets, and each combined series sorts once. Warm changed cut: resolve all source calendars, select/assemble VX for the new target, construct fresh cutoff metadata and issues, and share immutable normalized rows. No output or freshness TTL; no full-history JSON clone or raw normalization on every new cut.
boundedCost.historyPolicy: Over-limit bundles fail explicitly; no truncation to fewer than methodology-required horizons. Explicit observationDates may select original rows while retaining full raw bytes. Optional history coverage and BTC streak censoring remain engine semantics.
boundedCost.snapshotLimit: Root snapshot storage additionally bounds serialized snapshots to 16 MiB. An excessively large normalized bundle can therefore produce a recorded shadow failure; V1 isolation remains mandatory.
boundedCost.parseCountMeaning: sourceStatus.parseCount and captureMetadata.parseCount record original vintage normalization workload, not new parsing performed by each subsequent cut. Performance evidence instruments actual calls separately.
boundedCost.performanceFinding: M-PERF-01 combines the root Yahoo formatter hoist with bounded immutable-vintage preparation; consolidated finding and before/after performance evidence are maintained by root.

verification.rootNormalizerImplementationRepair: One canonical normalizer file changed by root for identical formatter reuse, covered by separate 19-case preservation evidence and all conformance checks. Frozen methodology is unchanged.

limitations: No actual official calendar packet has been configured by these synthetic tests.
No R1 vintage-reconstruction certification is implemented.
Provider identity and operator transcription remain a declared auditable boundary, not cryptographic provider authentication.
New full-history captures cannot immediately provide a complete strict R0 window. Warm-up or separately proved eligible source vintages are required.
No additional provider acquisition, paid data dependency or licensing redistribution has been introduced.

findings.description: Passing fresh packet-level capture metadata to a whole historical payload would label earlier rows R0.
findings.evidence: Regression tests distinguish current selected row R0 and older retained rows R2.
findings.repair: Per-row closed-session eligibility, upstream R2 preservation and weakest-parent aggregation in new source boundary.

findings.description: Frozen assembler's fallback observation end is date-only UTC day-end; a source with evidenced earlier settlement close would remain unavailable before day-end unless parent end is propagated.
findings.evidence: Complete synthetic R0 pipeline test initially showed only VX_NEAR_CONTRACTS_UNAVAILABLE, then passed after explicit max-near-parent observation end propagation.
findings.repair: New loader propagates the latest near-parent evidenced end using the source-specific calendar. No assembler/core/oracle modification.
